description.value: The Dayton Audio SS10-PR 10" Signature Series Passive Radiator makes it easy to extract powerful low end extension from compact enclosures, making it the ideal partner for the SS10-22 subwoofer. With the same rigid cast aluminum frame, anodized aluminum cone, and rubber surround as its active counterpart, the SS10-PR blends seamlessly into any build while handling the extreme excursion required by today’s high-output subwoofers. Thanks to Dayton Audio’s Sandwich Mass Structure (SMS) tuning system, customizing your system’s performance is quick, precise, and reliable.Product HighlightsSignature Series styling with cast aluminum frame, aluminum cone, and rubber surround — visually identical to the SS10-22 driverPassive radiator design eliminates port noise and enables deep bass from compact enclosuresEasy tuning with threaded bolt, wing nut, and nylock nut adjustment systemPassive radiator design eliminates port noise and enables deep bass from compact enclosuresIncludes five 75 g weights for precise mass loading and flexible tuning optionsPerfect companion for the Dayton Audio SS10-22 in compact subwoofer systemsProduct Manuals / Spec Sheets / DownloadsDayton Audio SS10-PR Specification SheetBuying OptionsBuy on Parts ExpressBuy Internationally
